title: Target anatomy
view: Front view of the whole skull, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left.
teachingPoint: The mental foramen sits on the anterior mandible below the premolars, on the same vertical line as the pupil, the supraorbital notch and the infraorbital foramen; the needle aims down toward it from the fold and stops short.
claims: Front view, patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Red band: the pupil line; on this skull the supraorbital notch, infraorbital foramen and mental foramen all fall within a vertical band about 9 mm wide (record: in line with the pupil).
Mental foramen directly below the lower second premolar, below the roots (record: below the first or second premolar).
Needle from the fold level below the premolars, directed inferiorly toward the foramen, stopping short (record).
Yellow: mental nerve branches to the lower lip and chin (standard anatomy).
Markings traced on the painting (owner accepted the whole, centred skull, 2026-10-02).
Labels: Supraorbital notch, Infraorbital foramen, Second premolar, Mental foramen, Pupil line.
